title: Living Ecosystem — Growth POC
description: Rendering approaches for a connected living world: ten painted growth states, a real-time 3D island, an image + live overlay hybrid, a 20-theme grand world, the raw gallery art on one continent, one continuous 20-theme painting with real growth stages, five smaller worlds of four related themes each with deep-zoom close-up ecosystems, and a world-tour navigation test that glides between painted worlds with swipe or arrows and frees zoom + drag inside each theme - each with live performance measurements.
